properties.name: Angkor Wat
properties.description: Largest religious monument ever built, originally Hindu (dedicated to Vishnu), later Buddhist. Represents Mount Meru, home of the gods.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, Cambodia's symbol

properties.name: Ellora Caves — Kailasa Temple
properties.description: The Kailasa Temple is carved from a single rock — the world's largest monolithic structure. Represents Mount Kailash, Shiva's abode.

properties.name: Jagannath Temple — Puri
properties.description: One of the four sacred dhams. Home to annual Rath Yatra (chariot festival) when 500,000+ pull the massive chariot. Origin of the word 'juggernaut.'
properties.modernStatus: Active Hindu temple, major pilgrimage site

properties.name: Khajuraho Temples
properties.description: Medieval Hindu and Jain temples famous for erotic sculptures depicting the union of human and divine. 25 of original 85 temples survive.

properties.name: Konark Sun Temple
properties.description: 13th century temple shaped as a massive chariot of the sun god Surya, with 24 intricately carved wheels and seven horses. Considered a masterpiece.

properties.name: Mount Kailash
properties.description: Sacred to Hindus, Buddhists, Jains, and Bonpo. Believed to be Shiva's throne. No one has ever climbed it — considered too holy to touch.
properties.modernStatus: Pilgrimage site, restricted access via China

properties.name: Prambanan Temple
properties.description: Largest Hindu temple in Indonesia with 240 temples. Central temple dedicated to Shiva rises 47m. Ramayana reliefs circle the main temples.

properties.name: Varanasi — City of Light
properties.description: Oldest continuously inhabited city in the world. Sacred to Shiva. Dying here grants moksha (liberation). Ghats line the sacred Ganges.
properties.modernStatus: Active pilgrimage city, millions of visitors annually
